prompts.name: 02-cabin-roof
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: honest used-vehicle sale listing photograph. Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL PHOTO and sole edit target, the exact real vehicle. Make only subtle professional photographic corrections: neutral natural white balance, balanced exposure with gentle shadow recovery and protected highlights, very mild perspective/lens correction and careful tighter crop within the existing image. No new viewpoint and no outpainting. Photorealistic documentary result, not a render. Retain every visible condition detail including stains, dust, discoloration, scratches, creases, cracks, dents, wear and all original hardware. Never repair, replace, clean or improve the vehicle's actual condition. No aesthetic smoothing, synthetic sharpening, HDR or added equipment. Do not invent or reinterpret text or labels. Focus on the cabin roof and both front seats. Correct the pronounced green cast to neutral warm gray/beige, gently brighten the rear seats, and slightly reduce wide-angle distortion. Make a modest tighter composition by trimming uninformative outer edges only; keep sunroof panel, dome lamps, front seats and headrests clearly in view. The sunroof and roof must keep exactly their original geometry, handles, visor warning label, switches, seams, headliner stain near the front edge of sunroof panel and all other headliner wear. Preserve the original front-seat wrinkles, creasing and uneven coloration without inventing new cracks. Preserve the lit amber dome lamp and original exterior seen through windows. There is no meaningful loose clutter; remove nothing from this photo.
